posts.title: a dream poem
posts.description: Your blood runs through me Keeps me warm On cold nights

posts.title: attrition
posts.description: A boy grows old not by the hour or the day the year but by the deep soul tired months that drag The moth on a pyre of scroll doomed to deem his own flight he is flushed, rushed and jubilant a bed of feather and vanity If old was tired and tired old age would graph beautiful time grafted to growing a buck moth bucking hot air Still a man grows old, soul tired parchment burning deep before deeper dr

posts.title: poem from marconi
posts.description: Let the grass grow Unfettered to your blade And Glad in the shine Neuter these neutral grounds No more; Let them wild As forgotten graves Grave in their spiteful celebration
